text: The Trinity Shamrocks Girls Basketball team is off to their best start in nearly two decades, large in part due to a complete buy-in from the players into their new head coach, two-time NBA champion Norris Cole. However, the opportunity with the Shamrocks emerged through his wife who happens to be from the Central Pennsylvania area, and from there he's never looked back.FOX 43

text: Leading the Shamrocks best start since the ‘06/’07 season with 11-straight wins, Cole is on a banner winning path to add a first to an already decorated basketball career.However, like the mindset he embraces while playing and now preaches to his team, there is always work to be done. "It’s hard for me to get a first, because I've experienced a lot, so this will actually be a first, but I don't think that far ahead, because we have so far to go," said Cole. "Success is a process, and you have to take step by step, but I think the girls are up for the challenge, and I'm going to be here to support them and help them."FOX 43

text: That’s why now, after having been in the NBA for 18 years, Love feels the need to apologize to players like Rubio. Because by Love’s estimation, Rubio understood the value of a being a good teammate.“He radiated goodness,” Love says. “He radiated team, and he built guys up.”deseret.com

text: Also similar to Young, I've been told that Morant is as quietly open to a change of scenery away from Memphis as his counterpart was to leaving Atlanta. The Grizzlies' decision to canvas the market for a Morant deal is believed to be a mutually agreed-upon path forward. The sense I have, at this juncture, is that Memphis wants its rebuild to revolve around Jaren Jackson Jr. after the Grizzlies made salary-clearing moves this past offseason to enable them to renegotiate and extend Triple J’s contract. Some around the league actually viewed that chain of events as the unofficial shift for the franchise to become Jackson-centric rather than Morant's team. The sample size is undeniably small, but Memphis produced an encouraging 7-2 stretch in November during games Jackson played without Morant at his side.marcstein.substack.com
